verdict.reason: Every plugin capability was exercised successfully at least once, but msc_delta/cold completed the artifact after only one context call and therefore failed its two-call protocol gate.

scope.task_summary: Read repository policy and current metrics, then create a validated release-plan JSON artifact.
scope.primary_system_prompt_difference: The initial full campaign still rendered each condition's absolute disposable workspace path in the headless global persona.
scope.post_fix_first_request_ab_components: system, messages, and generation are identical; only the expected tool component differs.

feature_matrix.evidence: no_memory exposed no memory tool and recorded zero memory calls in every baseline run.
legacy_full completed cold and warm with one context call in each phase.
msc_full completed cold and warm with one context call in each phase.
msc_progressive/cold used context plus memory_explain; warm used context only, demonstrating selective expansion.
msc_delta/warm and both msc_delta_core phases produced delta hits; msc_delta/cold skipped the required second call.
msc_context_only completed the non-code artifact with one argument-free memory_context call.
All primary runs reported stale_memory_uses=0 and cross_project_leaks=0 despite both canaries being present.
Every completed provider request has provider_exact input, cache-miss, cache-hit, output, latency, request hash, and cost evidence.
The plugin installed into a fresh Harness home; real Loader HMR disabled and re-enabled memory schemas while leaving usage collection mounted.
The final four-request supplement matched cold/warm first-request hash, bytes, and system/messages/tools/generation component hashes for baseline and treatment.

ab_results.note: One paired sample; do not interpret the small negative delta as a proven efficiency gain.
The final request-shape probe measured only +43 input tokens (+0.55%) before tool use; most full-task overhead came from the extra model round after retrieving memory.

ab_interpretation.task_success_comparison: Both baseline and every treatment produced a hidden-validator-passing artifact.
ab_interpretation.limitation: The primary full campaign preceded the global-persona path fix, so its literal system prompt contained condition-specific disposable paths. The final fixed probe proves all non-tool first-request components are now identical, but it intentionally stopped after one completed response per run.
ab_interpretation.required_follow_up_only_if_claiming_effe: Run a new multi-task completion study under plugin 0.1.6. It is not required to accept the feature surfaces themselves.

cache_prefix_supplement.cache_contrast_limitation: Both nominal cold and warm first requests were already mostly cache hits because earlier identical diagnostic prompts populated the provider's content-addressed cache. Request stability and exact cache accounting pass, but this supplement cannot estimate a cold-to-warm hit-rate uplift.

coupling_assessment.explanation: The task and validator are non-code and plugin-neutral. The DeepSeek-optimized Harness preset is model-specific, but it is frozen identically for A and B, so it cannot explain the treatment difference.
coupling_assessment.intentional_adapter_coupling: The plugin is explicitly pinned to DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.5, and the provider-visible request projection mirrors that pinned DeepSeek adapter wire contract. A Harness upgrade requires compatibility revalidation.

verification.warning: One unrelated Pydantic IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning remains in the test environment.

recommendation.release_position: Accept plugin 0.1.6 as an opt-in conditional functional release, not as proof of task-success improvement.
recommendation.delta_mode: Prefer msc_delta_core when a second call must be enforced; do not rely on free-form msc_delta adherence yet.
recommendation.easy_self_contained_tasks: Leave the plugin off unless memory is expected to contain necessary information.
